description: Na₄Ca₂SiP₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Si and five P atoms. The Na-Si bond length is 3.19 Å. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.27 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.06 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.85-2.98 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.06 Å. There are two inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five P atoms. There are a spread of Ca-P bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.06 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Si and six P atoms. The Ca-Si bond length is 3.14 Å. There are a spread of Ca-P bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.33 Å. Si is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one Na, one Ca, and four P atoms. There are a spread of Si-P bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.31 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to five Na, two equivalent Ca, and one Si atom. In the second P site, P is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na, three Ca, and one Si atom. In the third P site, P is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to four Na, three Ca, and one Si atom. In the fourth P site, P is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to four Na, three Ca, and one Si atom.
